item.title: Floer theory on based loops and fundamental groups of Lagrangians in $\mathbb{C}^n$
item.description: arXiv:2611.06574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We obtain new constraints on the topology of Lagrangian submanifolds in the standard symplectic vector space $\mathbb{C}^n$ using Floer theory on the based loop space, generalizing a theorem of Fukaya-Irie. In particular, we show that non-trivial connected sums of closed, spin, aspherical manifolds of even dimensions do not admit Lagrangian embeddings into $\mathbb{C}^n$. A feature of the proof is that the obstructedness of the Floer theory is used to constrain the fundamental group of the Lagrangian.
item.dc:creator: Shuhao Li

item.title: Toward Shifted symplectic Chiralization: Deformation of Courant Algebroids
item.description: arXiv:2611.06031v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the chiralization of Poisson--Lie theory through graded symplectic geometry. We compare Courant deformations and classical $r$- and $R$-matrix constructions, obtaining integrable hierarchies and free field realizations. We give a variational description of the obstruction to Lie conformal bialgebra compatibility and recover Liberati's obstruction in the Virasoro case. We also introduce a vertex bialgebra analogue of quantized universal enveloping algebras and construct explicit quantizations to all orders of Cartan type Lie conformal bialgebra structures on $\operatorname{Cur}(\mathfrak{sl}_2)$. These results contribute to the first author's broader programme of developing shifted symplectic chiralization as a geometric method for constructing chiral analogues of Poisson-Lie structures via $n$-shifted symplectic geometry, and exploring its connections with AKSZ theory and quantization.
item.dc:creator: Wenda Fang, Noriaki Ikeda

item.title: Finiteness and boundedness of positive monotone Hamiltonian GKM$_3$ spaces
item.description: arXiv:2606.28768v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper, we establish several finiteness and boundedness theorems for compact positive monotone symplectic manifolds endowed with special Hamiltonian actions, called GKM$_3$, which generalize smooth toric varieties. Specifically, we prove that, for fixed dimension and Euler characteristic, there are only finitely many complex cobordism classes of such spaces. Moreover, modulo lattice transformations, the moment map image can be embedded into a box of explicitly bounded size, and all Chern numbers satisfy quantitative bounds. In particular, this yields a bound on the volume of the underlying symplectic manifold, analogous to the one obtained by Koll\'{a}r-Miyaoka-Mori for Fano varieties. As a byproduct of our results, we also obtain that there are finitely many combinatorially maximal, labeled, reflexive GKM$_3$ graphs of valency $n$ and with $\chi$ vertices.
item.dc:creator: Panagiotis Konstantis, Silvia Sabatini, Leopold Zoller

item.title: A Proof of the Area Vanishing Square Peg Conjecture
item.description: arXiv:2610.21076v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We resolve an open problem posed by Tao related to the Toeplitz square peg conjecture. We prove that four simple closed polygonal curves in the cylinder, each winding once in the positive direction, jointly inscribe a square whenever the alternating sum of their $\int y\, dx$ integrals vanishes. The proof reduces the problem to the non-displaceability of a pair of Lagrangian tori, which we establish using Lagrangian Floer homology.
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Valerio

item.title: Ergodicity of a surgered flow on unit tangent bundle of hyperbolic surface
item.description: arXiv:2307.08126v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Starting with a trivial periodic flow on $\mathbb{S}M$, the unit tangent bundle of a genus two surface, we perform a Dehn-type surgery on the manifold around a tubular neighborhood of a curve on $\mathbb{S}M$ that projects to a self-intersecting closed geodesic on $M$, to get a surgered flow which restricted to the surgery region is ergodic with respect to the volume measure. The surgered flow projects to a map on the surgery track that can be taken to be a linked twist map with oppositely oriented shears which generates the ergodic behavior for sufficiently strong shears in the surgery.
item.dc:creator: Aritro Pathak
